learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Movement Sweat and Electrode Artifact.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: Sweat causes slow baseline drift; loose electrodes create pops, steps and intermittent noise; movement can affect many channels simultaneously.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Artifacts may be nonstationary and survive automated rejection. Video and technician notes are essential context.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Prevents false delta excess, false spikes and unreliable normative comparisons.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: Automated cleaning cannot rescue long segments of poor contact and movement.
